Name: Culinary Delight - New Cooking Recipes for Cornucopia Crops
Author: HeyKatu
Description:
I love Cornucopia, but I always felt a little disappointed that you couldn't cook with the crops it adds! So I made this mod, which adds 60+ new recipes cooked from modded ingredients.

[b]Unlock As You Play![/b]
The recipes are unlocked in various ways, from the normal routes such as purchasing or NPC friendship, but with a few twists! Two of the unlock methods have an alternative unlock option in the config, in case you get frustrated trying to obtain them. For spoilers on how each recipe unlocks, click below:

[spoiler]
[b][u]How to obtain all the recipes[/u][/b]:
[i]Many will be unlocked the day after the requirement is fulfilled. Alternative acquisition methods for two recipes can be chosen in the config.
[/i]

[b]Cook for Profit[/b]
With the exception of two default recipes, these dishes are guaranteed to give a profit based off of their ingredients (assuming you use basic quality).

[b]Powerful but Balanced Buffs[/b]
Almost every dish gives a buff, balanced to how early you can acquire it and how difficult it is to make.

[b]Gifting Customization and Unique Dialogue[/b]
Plan on handing out your cooking as gifts? Each recipe has a list of NPCs who love or hate them! All loved and disliked gifts have unique dialogue for their associated NPCs!

[b][u][size=3]Mod Compatibility[/size][/u][/b]:
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19508]Cornucopia: More Crops[/url]﻿: [b]Required[/b]. Uses modded crops as ingredients.
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24842]Cornucopia: Artisan Machines[/url]﻿: [b]Required[/b]. Uses artisan goods like Butter, Garlic Mayo, Salt, and more.
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22728]Wildflour's Atelier Goods - Forager[/url]﻿: Optional. Uses both foraged items, crops, and artisan goods.
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9600]Visit Mount Vapius[/url]: Optional. Uses artisan goods such as butter.
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22490]Bonster's Crops[/url]: Optional. Not much overlap, but will use matching items from this mod.
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10950]Jean and Jorts[/url]: Optional. When installed, Jean and Jorts will have custom gifting reactions for some items in the mod.
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]: The Wizard's name will change to Magnus if you have SVE installed. Crops introduced by SVE can be used in the recipes.
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17059]Diverse Stardew Valley[/url]: Now supports Jewish Elliott, George, and Evelyn. Thanks to Airyn for doing all the work!
